title: Gearworks — Mechanism Designer
description: Build gear trains and belt drives by hand — mesh, motorize, and watch real torque and direction propagate through your machine.
concept: A mechanical sandbox for designing gear-driven mechanisms. Place gears of any tooth count, add a motor to drive them, and watch angular velocity and direction propagate correctly through meshed gears (which reverse direction) and belts (which don't). Three built-in presets teach classic mechanism patterns — reduction trains, reverse idlers, and belt drives — and any mechanism you build can be saved, exported, or shared as a link.
features: Place and motorize gears with adjustable tooth count, RPM, and direction
Automatic mesh detection with magnetic snapping when gears touch
Belt/chain tool for linking non-adjacent gears in the same rotational direction
Graph-based physics propagates real angular velocity and direction through the whole train
Three educational presets: reduction train, reverse idler, belt drive
Save/load named mechanisms to localStorage, export a PNG, or copy a shareable URL
tech: Graph BFS for gear-train velocity propagation

interaction.mouse: Drag gears to reposition them — they snap into mesh when their teeth touch a neighbor
interaction.click: Pick a tool (Gear, Motor, Belt, Erase) from the toolbar, then click the canvas to place or connect pieces
interaction.touch: Fully touch-driven — tap to place, drag to move, tap-tap to wire a belt between two gears
interaction.keyboard: None required — the whole app is pointer-driven
